tests.name: conditional_independence_base_duration_vs_momentum
tests.comparison: Among entities binned on mom_20 (±0.02), ma10_slope_5 (±0.005), up_day_ratio_20 (±0.10), ma20_slope_5 (±0.005), test whether base_duration_weeks adds incremental AUC beyond the four momentum/slope features alone. Use logistic regression with momentum features only as baseline, then add base_duration_weeks. Report AUC delta.
tests.success_criterion: AUC improvement < 0.005 when adding base_duration_weeks to momentum baseline, supporting redundancy with base_duration_weeks as the freshness proxy
tests.failure_criterion: AUC improvement >= 0.005, indicating base_duration_weeks captures independent temporal structure not reducible to MA slopes and momentum

tests.name: mutual_information_conditional_on_momentum
tests.comparison: Compute conditional mutual information: I(selected_winner; base_duration_weeks | mom_20, ma10_slope_5, up_day_ratio_20, ma20_slope_5) and I(selected_winner; pullback_pct | same conditions). This directly tests whether temporal/freshness signals have residual information after conditioning on momentum features, addressing the skeptic's information-theoretic challenge.
tests.success_criterion: Both conditional mutual information values < 0.01 bits, confirming freshness (via base_duration and pullback) adds negligible information beyond momentum
tests.failure_criterion: Either conditional mutual information >= 0.01 bits, confirming freshness captures independent signal not in momentum features

tests.name: regime_stratified_redundancy_test
tests.comparison: Split the 27 cases into high-momentum (mom_20 > median of 0.163) and low-momentum (mom_20 <= 0.163) regimes. Within each regime, perform the conditional independence test: does base_duration_weeks improve AUC beyond the three momentum features? This addresses the skeptic's concern that freshness may be redundant for high-momentum but critical for low-momentum entities.
tests.success_criterion: AUC improvement < 0.005 in BOTH regimes, confirming unconditional redundancy across the full momentum spectrum
tests.failure_criterion: AUC improvement >= 0.005 in low-momentum regime only, indicating freshness is non-redundant specifically for moderate/low-momentum setups

tests.name: pullback_recovery_signal_test
tests.comparison: The numeric contrast shows pullback_pct standardized_delta=+0.6404 (false negatives have less deep pullbacks), indicating a temporal-recovery effect. Test whether this signal is captured by slope features (current velocity) or represents independent recovery behavior across time. Specifically, test if pullback_pct has significant standardized coefficient after conditioning on all MA/momentum features.
tests.success_criterion: pullback_pct standardized coefficient < 0.05 when added to full momentum feature set, confirming it is redundant with current-slope encoding
tests.failure_criterion: pullback_pct standardized coefficient >= 0.05, confirming pullback recovery captures temporal signal distinct from current momentum velocity

tests.name: ruin_within_high_momentum_cases
tests.comparison: Identify high-momentum entities (mom_20 > 0.20) and test what distinguishes selected_winner from false_positive_ruin outcomes within this subset. Specifically compare entity_6618d3e80c (selected_winner|false_positive_ruin, mom_20=0.251, base_duration_weeks missing) vs entity_3472243e0c (false_positive_ruin, mom_20=0.242, base_duration_weeks missing). If freshness is redundant, no temporal feature should discriminate within high-momentum; if freshness is unique, base_duration_weeks or pullback metrics should differ.
tests.success_criterion: No significant difference in base_duration_weeks or pullback metrics between selected_winner and false_positive_ruin within high-momentum subset, supporting redundancy
tests.failure_criterion: Significant difference in temporal features between outcome classes within high-momentum subset, indicating freshness filters high-momentum cases independently

leakage_checks: All features used are PIT-observable: mom_20, ma10_slope_5, ma20_slope_5, up_day_ratio_20, pullback_pct, pullback_duration_weeks, base_duration_weeks, vol_ratio_5_20. No forward-looking features.
selected_winner outcome label is derived from W4 >= 8% AND >= 5pp above B0 selected median OR >= 5pp above worst B0 pick — this is the pre-specified outcome definition, not a leak.
No entity identity features (entity_anon) used as inputs — only numeric features.
No calendar/snapshot features (snapshot_anon) used as inputs — only structural features.
The failure_archaeology case set is discovery-train only per method_note — must not use for final validation.
